## Summary

Describe the change and the evidence or documentation it affects.

## Verification

- [ ] Direct observations are separated from interpretations.
- [ ] New claims link to primary artifacts or authoritative sources.
- [ ] Sensitive information and credentials have been removed.
- [ ] Local Markdown links resolve.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.
- [ ] The source PDFs were not modified.

## Limitations

List alternative explanations, evidence dependencies, or unresolved questions.
